scope: Four hand-written illustrative challenge cases; not a representative benchmark or a training/tuning dataset. Expected labels are human judgments documented with rationale.

cases.name: Unsupported completed refund
cases.kb_article: Refunds may be requested within 30 days of a charge. This applies to all plans. Approved refunds are returned to the original payment method and typically settle within 5 business days.
cases.draft_reply: I have processed your refund. The money will reach your original payment method within 5 business days.
cases.reason: The policy describes eligibility and settlement, but contains no evidence that a refund was executed.

cases.name: Incorrect plan restriction
cases.kb_article: Refunds may be requested within 30 days of a charge. This applies to all plans.
cases.draft_reply: Only enterprise customers can request a refund within 30 days of the charge.
cases.reason: The reply excludes free and pro customers despite the article explicitly covering all plans.

cases.name: Incorrect deadline
cases.kb_article: Customers may request a refund within 14 days of the charge.
cases.draft_reply: Customers may request a refund within 30 days of the charge.

cases.name: Supported policy paraphrase
cases.kb_article: Customers may request a refund within 14 days of the charge.
cases.draft_reply: You can ask for a refund within two weeks of the charge.
cases.reason: The draft restates the policy without claiming an action happened.
